_provenance.upstream_operation: sigGen groups needing rnd and/or the internal interface: hedged external pure/preHash (tg 13-18), hedged internal (tg 20/22/24), hedged internal external-mu (tg 19/21/23), deterministic internal (tg 8/10/12)
_provenance.local_operation: C_SignInit with CK_PQCTODAY_[HASH_]SIGN_ADDITIONAL_CONTEXT_EXT (pRandom = upstream rnd) on CKM_ML_DSA / CKM_HASH_ML_DSA_<hash> (generic CKM_HASH_ML_DSA with hash = CKM_SHA512_224/256 and data PH(M) for those hashAlgs) / CKM_ML_DSA_EXTERNAL_MU; every internal group (deterministic and hedged) through standard CKM_ML_DSA_EXTERNAL_MU with mu = SHAKE256(SHAKE256(pk,64) || M', 64) (owner decision D6); signature byte-compared
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained group field and test field is byte-copied from the upstream file (only 'deferred' dropped)
_provenance.subset_policy: Two cases per in-scope group, the shortest messages among hashAlg values that have a PKCS#11 CKM_HASH_ML_DSA_<hash> mechanism (ties by lowest tcId), plus every SHA2-512/224 and SHA2-512/256 case (run through generic CKM_HASH_ML_DSA, owner decision D5).
_provenance.retained_fields: group fields as upstream; tcId, message|mu, rnd, pk, sk, context, hashAlg, signature
_provenance.test_only_key_material: sk/dk values are public NIST ACVP-Server sample data, imported into session (CKA_TOKEN=false) objects and destroyed after the case; they are not secrets
_provenance.note: Optional caller-supplied test input (acvp-explicit-randomness-model plan, P4): src/lib/test/OptionalRandomInputTests.cpp byte-compares every retained case. The full in-scope set (81 groups / 909 cases) runs from the upstream files when ACVP_OPTIONAL_INPUT_FULL_DIR points at them.
